verdict.rationale: Browserbase provides programmatic browser control through an SDK [browserbase-docs-4, browserbase-docs-22], which implies you could write your own selector-based extraction scripts. It also offers URL-to-HTML/JSON conversion [browserbase-docs-3]. However, its documented selector story is natural-language selectors via its agent SDK [browserbase-docs-5], not CSS or XPath rules. Missing for 10: any explicit documentation of CSS or XPath selector support, a declarative field-extraction rule mechanism, and hands-on or independent corroboration of selector-based extraction.
